questions.q: Which actor plays the villain Shibu in the 2021 Malayalam superhero film?
questions.why: Tamil actor Guru Somasundaram plays Shibu, a social outcast.

questions.q: What is Shibu's job at the start of the film?
questions.why: Shibu is an outcast who works at a teashop in the village.

questions.q: Which woman has Shibu loved since childhood?
questions.why: His obsession with childhood love Usha drives his path to tragedy.

questions.q: Which actress plays the woman Shibu has loved since childhood?
questions.why: Shelly Kishore plays Usha, with Vyshnavi Narayan as the young Usha.

questions.q: Who dies when Shibu burns down the tailor shop in anger?
questions.why: Usha's brother Daasan dies in the fire Shibu sets after he opposes the relationship.

questions.q: How does Shibu avoid blame for the shop fire?
options: He blames a short circuit in the wiring
He frames Minnal Murali for it
questions.why: Shibu poses as the fake Minnal Murali and frames the hero for the crime.

questions.q: Why does Shibu rob a bank after getting his powers?
options: To pay for surgery for Usha's daughter
To bail out his friend from a loan shark
questions.why: He wants the money for the surgery, not knowing it has already been paid for.

questions.q: Where do Shibu and Jaison fight, leaving a vehicle hanging over a cliff?
questions.why: Their bus fight ends with the vehicle dangling over a cliff until Jaison saves it.

questions.q: Where does Jaison confront Shibu for the final fight?
questions.why: Shibu terrorises a church congregation, and Jaison defeats him there.
